description: This source file contains a custom Liquibase changeset class named 'DuplicateEncounterTypeNameChangeSet' designed to identify and resolve duplicate encounter type names in the OpenMRS database. It performs validation, automatic renaming, and update procedures for encounter types with duplicate names, ensuring uniqueness by appending suffixes.

classes.name: DuplicateEncounterTypeNameChangeSet
